note: Small, remote Forest Service campground along Greendale Brook in Weston, about 3 miles up Greendale Road (FR 18), a narrow two-lane dirt road off Route 100. Wooded sites with parking spurs; the Forest Service says most take small campers, so a 23-ft rig may find few that fit. Trailhead for the 4-mile Greendale Loop. --Claude

flags: CRITERIA (rig-length wording): the FS page and recreation.gov both single out this campground: 'Most sites can accommodate small campers as well as tents.' It is not GMNF boilerplate (Moosalamoo, Grout Pond and Silver Lake pages carry no such line; Chittenden Brook states its own 18-ft trailer limit). No stated length; the recreation.gov catalog lists 11 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites with no lengths or equipment. No review from the last 3 years in which a 23-ft+ rig fit was found (Campendium's review page answered a Cloudflare/WP Engine block - not retried). Access is a 'narrow two-lane dirt road' (FR 18), no warning beyond that. Per AWH 2026-11-02 an unclear fit keeps the entry with a caveat (proposed note carries it).

SITES: max_rig_ft 24 (derived from old note prose 'best for RVs under ~24 ft') cleared - neither the FS page nor recreation.gov states a length now. Inclusion evidence ('spurs limit to RVs generally under 30 ft') is likewise unsourced on the current pages; proposed replacement: 'fs.usda.gov Greendale Campground + recreation.gov 10389176 (2026-11-16): 11 drive-in sites with parking spurs, $10 FCFS, "Most sites can accommodate small campers" -> drive-in campground, small-rig caveat'.
